title: Your next customer is an AI.
sub: Researchers sent AI assistants to 1,500+ organisations, the way customers now do.

items.text: could not accept an agent connection at all
blocked agents that said what they were
let a customer approve an agent for one limited task
had published any position on AI agents

take: Turn an agent away and it **books somewhere else**. The lost sale never shows up in your numbers.
source: Encore AI Agent Readiness Index, via Fortune, 27/10/2026
